# note: reads = simulated reads whose primary has MAPQ 0 (the aligner's tie); identity_band 'all' = every band

# note: family_certificate = the per-family run's row for the read's TRUE family (score.py reads OWN; uses the truth to pick the row: the certificate's intrinsic accuracy); per_family_table = any assigned row of the default per-family run (score.py reads ANY; two loci claimed = conflict); union_certificate = any assigned row of the --union-certificate run; aligner_primary = the catalog copy the primary alignment overlaps most (correct = the source copy's locus by score.same_locus, wrong = another catalog copy, not_scored = no catalog copy)

# note: coverage = (correct + wrong + conflict) / n_reads; accuracy = correct / (correct + wrong + conflict); abstain = a row with no copy assigned; not_scored = no row in the table (or, for the aligner, a primary outside every catalog copy); verdicts from score.py reads --per-read

# note: acc_lo / acc_hi: 95% interval with the SOURCE COPY as the unit (reads from one copy are not independent): none when fewer than 5 copies are assigned (acc_ci too_few_copies); else cluster bootstrap over copies (2000 resamples, seed 20260925, percentile), or, when every copy has the same ratio (e.g. every assigned read correct) and the bootstrap is degenerate, the Wilson interval at the pooled ratio with the n_copies_assigned copies as the sample size (acc_ci says which); n_copies = distinct source copies of the band's tied reads

# note: n_family_psv (family_certificate rows only) = tied reads whose true family's row has >= 1 decisive PSV (score.py reads --per-read own_n_decisive >= 1; truth-selected like that reading); n_nm_twin (union_certificate rows only) = tied reads with an NM-identical twin (_o2.twin_state nm_twin: a placement not overlapping the source copy with the best AS and the true-copy placement's NM)
